notes.title: Hotfix #2 😺🔧
notes.content:
Meowdy Rangers! 

We've rustled up some fixes, with more on the way, thank you so much for your love and support! 
Here's a list of fixes for you!


Key Binding Issues:

Previous bound keys are no longer removed. Note: There is still a 'replace' prompt screen that appears when trying to change a key binding already in use, but it will not replace it. Players can now assign keys wherever they wish. The 'replace' pop-up will be removed in the next patch, but for the current purposes, this issue is fixed.

Controller Menu:

 Players can now use the controller to select menu options with a button press, eliminating the need to navigate via the radial menu.

Apple Spawn Rate Increase:

 Increased the spawn rates of apples. Inconsistent spawns were leading to frustration, especially for the opening quest where players need to collect 3 apples. There should now be plentiful amounts available for players to complete the quest.

Stickball Achievement:

 Stickball achievement now works correctly.

Log Spawning:

 Logs now spawn on the ground, resolving floating log issues.




Please report any bugs or issues you encounter while playing the game here, and we will do our best to address them!

We have more fixes on the way so make sure to follow us here and on socials!

notes.title: See you in two weeks!
notes.content:
Releasing onto all platforms on April 25th!

Meowdy Rangers! We're looking forward to showing off the little world of Whisker Waters with you, so we're bringing a quick recap of what to look forward to! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/0a73f87e0b92633c4e062ed0b4fc6c423277ce0e.png

The Story
You'll be assuming the mantle, collar, or fishing rod of a Ranger! A group that, in history, was tasked with maintaining balance among the animal tribes by protecting the environment, managing trade between them, and ensuring healthy fish populations, until something halted this endeavor...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/d4c3bbe82fc822c387857a2f56b729318a556537.png

The Role-Playing Gattos
You'll need to keep in mind a few stats while fishing, on the surface is a cosy, warm cat-fishing game, but lurking underneath the surfact is a surprising beast of RPG mechanics! Here's only a few:

 Scare - This measures how much you will startle a fish while attempting to hook it, scare it too much and it'll run away.
 Efficiency - Efficiency is how much stamina is used while attempting to pull a fish in, higher efficiency means you can fight a fish for longer.
 Cast - Higher case means you throw your rod out further and have more opportunities to entice more fish. 
 Lean - This modifies how strong you are in reeling a snagged fish in-between mini-games!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/f81208a3f0832c3e433ccf5a971ee4e1a02979bc.png

The Fishing
Factors such as location, time of day, bait, and rod type must all be taken into account before casting your rod! Once your fish is hooked, there are over 24 ways they will challenge you with time, accuracy, and control-based mini-games, influenced by the reel you have to assist you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/9b92cee6793dbc18f3e924b53d004c926ff6f9d2.png

Thanks for reading rangers! make sure to mark your calendars and Wishlist us so you don't miss out! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171570/Whisker_Waters/

notes.title: Meet The Cast of Whisker Waters!
notes.content:
Cats are the cast of Whisker Waters because every show needs its stars. We predicted that the first thing people will do when making their cat is to base it on their own pet! So when coming up with the textures and fur designs, we decided to use our own little models to base them on! 

Luna
Traditional designs like tuxedo cats are fairly common and pretty important to get right, they're one of the most popular patterns, as well as looking rather sophisticated in general!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/0bf63eff4986d1f8f7b238a5c3abf2aba49385dd.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/c5c128a4e8ce926cdfaf953e1cc58c45a496210e.png


Milo and Eevee
For our voidcat enthusiasts, we know that even with black cats, their owners know exactly the intracacies of their cats, for example Eevee has a little tuft of white, and Milo is turning a little bit rusty in his old age, both of which we're happy to reflect in their coats despite being black cats!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/1b37e349549d17094b35c3319c00438ee19c3119.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/a5d891e898fdfb6c7f22942d92b21464614d0fc1.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/9b99d003a518fb5b6f7056b925929bea624eb2b0.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/4b5b934f53d931e87cad3deff833e66402ea50ed.png


Nala
Though not all cats are as simple those traditional coats, Nala here is very asymmetrical, like somebody stopped painting him half-way through. Though, one of a kind he may seem, he probably also reflects a lot of other cats out there, so it's important that we reflect his design as a texture option!


 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/6803e58682cffdf59825b2d75b44501511c45f98.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/cef0dd02e909eada5ff23cd9190110e7a2ab1fa7.png

If you're looking forward to making your cat in Whisker Waters, make sure to wishlist us so you don't miss out!

notes.title: A closer look at fishing mechanics!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/14bf09b7945c13d1c3e3a3bc01b125b2271a9fbe.png
Fishing! It's going to be one of the main things you do in Whisker Waters, required to complete quests, to make money and to improve your gear! As the core gameplay loop, you'll need to hunt and manage your baits, learn how to wrangle each individual fish and discover when, where and how to find them! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/e199849a85f32a7d27a17dfde6acfb006fa7546c.png
But before you cast your rod, you need to get hooked! There's no shortage of bait in Whisker Waters, collecting bugs from a bush, bartering for baits from a trader or running around with a sticky ball to hook them from over a pond, you'll need to keep track and good stock of various baits before you head fishing as a sharpened hook isn't the most appetizing meal for a fish!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/971c8a07b6ffbcf81010a46f3351013ab11cbb91.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/448d1ae5f61f78368d284ad429cb7091f9ed9a7b.png

Once your feline eyes are locked on to an agile little fishy, it's time to cast your rod! There's various upgrades available for your rod, as well as different baits and conditions to catch fish. In this instance, this 'Sedimophia' is only located at Fisherfolk bay, has a certain minigame associated with it, requiring you to overpower them and additionally has a taste for big beetles! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/c068a5223eda2577e7c8d8fc311f4015fd449adf.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/02b1084bbe97a7d3c1b8fd236ca1fe57389f7d8a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/aa4a935291961f598b38416266102f1386fb7ac6.png

Time is money and money is fish! Does that mean fish is time? I haven't thought this through properly. 
But to advance in Whisker Waters, you're going to need to get your barter on! trading fish for money, crafting items and upgrades is an important part of your journey as a ranger, certain fish are worth more, are rarer and harder to catch, such as the elusive Nightfish. As you progress, you'll have the tools to unlock better and better baits and equipment!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/c9b5a1bfc9f497ccbe48f61f5b16fb9e12048445.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616741/67d740cda508edebcc94d47075aa6e02355634f0.png
